order_note: The side is originated first, the total second and the moneyline third. The moneyline is not a separate opinion: it is priced FROM the originated side and the official standard deviation of the margin, so it cannot disagree with the side.
columns_note: fair line, market line and difference are three separate fields. A missing market line leaves the difference blank rather than implying a zero edge.
